Title: Philip Pullman Illegal Downloading is Moral Squalor
Elementary: Illegal downloading is morally wrong, and it is theft, the same as how putting your hand in someone’s pocket and stealing their wallet is theft, says author Philip Pullman. He criticizes Internet users who think it is OK to download music or books without paying for them.
